description:
Create a new project (folder/list) for organizing tasks.

WHEN TO USE:
- User wants to create a new task list, folder, or project
- Organizing tasks into categories or areas

REQUIRED: name (project title)

OPTIONAL:
- color: Hex color code (e.g., '#F18181')
- viewMode: 'list' (default), 'kanban', or 'timeline'
- kind: 'TASK' (default) for tasks, 'NOTE' for notes
- sortOrder: Position in project list

RETURNS: Created project with generated ID. Use this ID for subsequent task operations.

color.description: Project color in hex format (e.g., '#F18181'). Optional.

kind.description: Project type: 'TASK' for tasks or 'NOTE' for notes. Defaults to 'TASK'. Optional.

sortOrder.description: Sort order for the project. Optional.

viewMode.description: View mode for the project. Defaults to 'list'. Optional.

name: create_project
title: Create Project
